correctness.rationale: Direct overlap and Markov-transition probabilities yield all three covariance lags, whose weighted finite sum simplifies exactly to the displayed H_K expression. The identity H_{K+2}-H_K=4p(1-p)(3+(1-2p)^K)>0 proves even-n positivity and increasing odd thresholds; monotonicity in q=1-p gives uniqueness. The scaling limit H_K(1-z/K)->6z-1-exp(-2z) yields the root constant. The supplied standalone exact-enumeration checker passed 11,174 tests; it is not relied on for infinite proof.
